location_and_callers.capture: Frontend boundary events and resulting state; source inspected. Internal children not individually intercepted.

actual_input.capture_note: Exact available recorded inputs. File/DOM/library objects may be represented as opaque metadata; raw byte/array references remain authoritative.

expected_input: Original source URL, natural width/height and measured viewport bounds.

actual_output.capture_note: Return values are retained unchanged. captureError for JSON.stringify(undefined) is a recorder serialization limitation, not an application exception. Use observed resulting state for void methods.

expected_output_contract: The source image displayed with an aspect-preserving transform shared by its overlay. Letterboxing belongs to the viewport, not to native geometry.
expected_diagram: The source supplies no numerical L, m or θ. Pivot, bob, radius and initial visual angle can be grounded geometrically. Meter scale, mass and gravity require explicit assumptions or other evidence.
finding: The source-matched scene reaches the expected runtime. No new source-coordinate displacement was established at this boundary. See exact normalized scene and DOM evidence.
change_or_loss: Preserve source_px. The measured image rectangle and mapper offsets are shown in the coordinate stage; CSS pixels are not substituted into BookIR.
